inlines.v: COLT, noun 1. The young of the equine genus of animals or horse kind. In America, colt is equally applied to the male or female, and this is unquestionable correct. The male is called a house-colt, and the female is called a filly. 2. A young foolish fellow; a person without experience or stability. COLT, verb intransitive To frisk, riot or frolic, like a colt; to be licentious. COLT, verb transitive To befool.
